2.1.1. gss_export.config.Config¶

class gss_export.config.Config(out_dir, req_class_names, reporter, generic_header)¶

Configuration for api.export_gss

Methods

__init__(out_dir, req_class_names, reporter, …)
param out_dir:Path where the HLL files will be created.

Attributes

deviations_filename Path to the deviations file, relative to the project location.
generic_header Header to print at the top of SafetyProperties.hll.
out_dir Path where the HLL files will be created.
pre_namespace Name of the namespace where fresh inputs for PRE are declared (defaults to “P”).
reporter Object used to log notes, warnings and errors.
req_class_names List of names of GSS classes containing requirements.
req_namespace Name of the namespace where safety properties, sorts, parameter declarations and integration function declarations are put.
req_prefix Only requirements with this prefix will be included in the exported GSS.
strict_mode if True (the default), delete HLL files after an error occurs.
